31: def generate_pkce_pair() -> tuple[str, str]:
32:     """Generate a PKCE code verifier and challenge.
33: 
34:     Returns:
35:         Tuple of (verifier, challenge) where:
36:         - verifier: 43-128 character URL-safe string
37:         - challenge: base64url-encoded SHA256 hash of verifier
38:     """
39:     # Generate 32 bytes of random data (results in 43 chars after base64)
40:     random_bytes = secrets.token_bytes(32)
41:     verifier = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(random_bytes).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
42: 
43:     # Generate challenge: SHA256 hash of verifier, base64url encoded
44:     sha256_hash = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
45:     challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(sha256_hash).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
46: 
47:     return verifier, challenge
